quote.text: What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.

slides.summary: The world's largest wildlife crossing, a $114 million bridge over ten lanes of California's Highway 101, is set to open December 2, giving inbred Santa Monica Mountains lions a path to mates beyond the freeway.
slides.headline: Wildlife crossing opens over California Highway 101
slides.proves: Wildlife officials expect kittens born this year to a Simi Hills lion named P-113 to be among the first to use the bridge.

slides.summary: Payton Obert turned a childhood lemonade stand she started at age 8 into a charity network that has now raised $5 million for children facing illness and hardship across eight years.
slides.headline: Payton Obert's lemonade stand charity raised 5 million
slides.proves: A single child's fundraiser can grow into a registered nonprofit with stands running across six US states.

slides.summary: Vasi, a sloth bear rescued by Wildlife SOS in India after a snare trap cost him a leg, became the first bear in the world fitted with a prosthetic paw in September 2025.
slides.headline: Sloth bear Vasi fitted with prosthetic paw
slides.proves: Custom animal prosthetics already used on horses and birds can now restore a bear's ability to walk.

slides.summary: Arizona teen Jordan Hope gave the sneakers off his own feet to a struggling elderly stranger outside a Maricopa Walgreens, and the friendship that followed has raised more than $15,000 for the man.
slides.headline: Teen's sneaker gift sparked friendship raising 15000
slides.proves: A single act of kindness, once shared online, can draw more than $15,000 in community support for one person.

slides.summary: All 32 patients in the NEOPRISM-CRC trial stayed free of bowel cancer recurrence for 33 months after a nine week course of pembrolizumab before surgery, far beating the 25% relapse rate expected with standard chemotherapy.
slides.headline: Pembrolizumab kept bowel cancer from returning 33 months
slides.proves: Blood tests tracking tumor DNA could let doctors identify which patients can safely skip extra chemotherapy after surgery.
